description: This file defines the Language class within the OpencartrSystemrEngine namespace. It provides methods to retrieve language data from a database, including fetching by ID, by code, and listing available languages. It extends a base Model class and manages language-related data for the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents the localisation language entity, providing methods to retrieve language details by ID or code, and to list all available languages.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves language data based on the provided language ID, either from cache or database, and enriches the data with image URL constructions.

methods.name: getLanguageByCode
methods.description: Fetches language data using the language code, from cache or database, and constructs image URL paths.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns a list of all active languages, querying the database and caching the results for performance.
